name: Cats
summary: The engine draws pixel art: ink sprites with palettes, a pixel world at whole-pixel scale, and the Pixelator panel to look at them.
changes: Pixel kit: ink sprites, palettes and shaded shapes drawn from code (D62). See Docs/Graphics/PixelArt.md.
Pixel world: the artPixel project setting draws the world on an art-pixel grid with hard edges at any window size; pixelUi pixelates the HUD too (D63).
Pixelator panel and ctl pixels: frames, inks, lint, onion skin, tiling, diff and PNG/GIF export for pixel graphics (D64, D65).

breaking.change: The smoothCanvas project setting is gone; artPixel decides between a smooth and a pixel project.
